author: root Codex

decisions.A: Same fixed cohort/one join/monotonic epoch/capacity/ports and READ+WRITE authority contract admits concrete O-ring with identical P,R_V,R_A,W_V,W_A and min-W reclaim. Therefore payload pooling, masks elimination or late replay are not independent algorithm contributions in this contract. No extra late/continuous fixture or RTL.
decisions.C: Original DARTS source proves transfer-cost/unlocked-compute selection, one-from-free singleton fallback and reference-protected consumption. No ACK skeleton novelty. Natural translation-as-data mapping loses setup cost, independent capacity or post-copy translation lifetime. This is a real original-source mismatch, not a proof of whole-field novelty. Complete common-executor model must compare hot-page, ordinary max_closure/setup_density and clearly labelled marginal-unlock proxy.
decisions.C_platform: Actual IOTLB matches PSCID/GSCID/stages and page (legal global/disabled-stage exceptions explicit in source). Model shares setups only within one declared legal translation domain; different physical payload on same page is not cross-context authority. Extension to isolated V/A or device IDs is unknown.
decisions.B: Current compact source-child exact-W-cover restriction may exclude the proposed slot-release state. New microarchitecture must make full short-return reservation/independent AR admission explicit and identical for all policies. Priority inheritance is already established; global full wait-graph baseline must be charged same information and tested before claiming algorithm novelty.

assumptions: C static known costs and one hot destination page; overlap and finite storage charged equally. No real application trace, cold-target result, actual combined-IOTLB result, synthesis or FPGA speed claim.
